The acronym GAB is a useful memory technique to remember the final 
conversation before the client leaves the office. Before the client heads out 
the door, “GAB” with him for a few minutes:
Goals: Invite the client to share one last time what behavior or thought 
pattern he will attempt to change.
Assess confidence: Use a scaling question to assess the client’s
